title: Blow-up asymptotics for a critical Hartree-type Brézis--Nirenberg problem in dimension three
summary: In this paper, we study the following critical Hartree problem \begin{equation}\label{equationabstract} \begin{cases} \displaystyle-Δu+(Q+\varepsilon V)u= A_{3,μ} \left(\int_Ω\frac{u^{6-μ}(y)}{|x-y|^μ}dy\right) u^{5-μ} &\mathrm{~in~}Ω,\\ \displaystyle u>0&\mathrm{~in~}Ω,\\u=0&\mathrm{~on~}\partialΩ,\end{cases} \end{equation} where $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ is a bounded open set, $0 0$ is a normalization constant.
